description:
FILED s473a (Opus, 2026-09-07) while shipping #1243 (a).

A sub whose only dynamic scoping is a `local` of a MAGIC scalar name -- one
bound by a plain CL `let` rather than through `p-local-cell` -- can come out
with `:needs ()` where the body really does save and restore.  The IR then
tells a backend "no :dynamic_scope.* means no save/restore stack"
(cl/pcl-runtime.lisp:803, plan-speed-and-ir-s470 B.3) about a sub that needs
one.  Target B (a clear IR), not a run-time bug: nothing branches on :needs.

MECHANISM.  Pl::Manifest counts `dynamic_scope.local` as (p-local-* heads) +
(p-box-for-local) - (the wraps) -- its own comment at Manifest.pm:206-218 says
`p-box-for-local` is "sometimes the site's only marker", and that is exactly
the `let`-bound magic-name case.  A local whose binding value is NOT
`p-box-for-local` therefore vanishes from the count.

MEASURED (pl2cl over three one-line subs, s473a):

  sub f { local $\; print "x" }        -> :needs (:io)                  <- PRE-EXISTING hole
  sub g { local $\ = ""; print "y" }   -> :needs (:dynamic_scope.local :io)
  sub h { local($\) = ""; print "z" }  -> :needs (:io)                  <- since s473a

The bare spelling (f) was already under-declared before this session; s473a
added the parenthesised one (h) by routing a parenthesised scalar target
through the list-assignment path, whose slot binding is `(make-p-box nil)`.
Reached in the shipped tree by lib/IO/Handle.pm only (two subs: `local($\) =
""` and `local($^A) = $^A`), found by `tools/emission-ab.pl --shapes --list
lib/**/*.pm` -- 13 files, 12 SAME, 1 DIFF, RCDIFF 0.

WHY IT WAS NOT FIXED THERE.  The obvious fix -- bind a localized SCALAR slot
with `(p-box-for-local nil)` instead of `(make-p-box nil)`, which restores the
marker for BOTH spellings and costs one `box-set` of nil -- was written and
MEASURED: `tools/corpus-diff.pl 41ca2496` went from IDENTICAL to dozens of
differing files (range.t readline.t ref.t splice.t split.t sub.t substr.t
time.t unshift.t vec.t and more), because every bare `local $x;` and every
multi-target `local` in the corpus takes that branch.  That is a corpus-wide
emission change to fix an annotation, and it belongs in its own commit with
its own sweep, not inside a semantics fix.

FIX SHAPE when taken: either that one-line binding change (with the full sweep
and every differing file explained -- the diffs should all be
`(make-p-box nil)` -> `(p-box-for-local nil)` inside a local's let, and nothing
else), or teach Pl::Manifest to recognise a localization by the SHAPE of the
let rather than by the value form.  The first is preferable: it makes the
marker uniform, which is what Manifest.pm's own comment asks for.

BAR: the three probe subs above all reading `:dynamic_scope.local`; corpus-diff
explained file by file; the full sweep clean; `tools/ir-host-leak.pl` clean.
subject: Target B: a `local` of a MAGIC scalar name bound by a plain `let` is invisible to Pl::Manifest, so the sub's `:needs` omits :dynamic_scope.local -- pre-existing for bare `local $\;`, widened by s473a to `local($\) = ""`; the one-line fix is corpus-wide emission churn
